## Summary

- What changed?
- Why is it needed?

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Security / privacy

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, credentials, or private user data were added.
- [ ] Authentication/authorization behavior was reviewed if applicable.
- [ ] External network access is intentional and allow-listed where applicable.

## Data / licensing

- [ ] New data/media has known provenance and redistribution rights.
- [ ] Third-party notices/licenses were preserved where required.

## Maintainer review

- [ ] Changes are appropriate for the public open-source repository.
